settings.molar_mass_basis: USGS kaolinite formula and source molar mass; metakaolin is kaolinite minus two H2O using the declared rounded steam molar mass. This is the chemically standard identity, not acceptance of the printed Al2O2 formula.
settings.cp_domain_basis: Only compare both source caloric functions within 298.15-700 K. No extension of kaolinite to source reactor output temperatures.

f3_diagnostic.parameter_basis: Ptacek2010 publisher abstract confirms these F3 values above410 C within its370-500 C study. No original full TG data acquired and no material transfer qualification.
f3_diagnostic.chemical_pool_assumption: Kaolinite plus one metakaolin formula unit per reacted kaolinite. Pure algebraic diagnostic, no real reactor volume or mixture input admission.
